newsitem.title: USA: Novacare to acquire Advanced Orthopedic.
newsitem.headline: Novacare to acquire Advanced Orthopedic.

text.p: NovaCare Inc said Wednesday it has signed a definitive agreement under which Advanced Orthopedic Technologies Inc will merge with a wholly owned NovaCare subsidiary.
The merger is being structured as an all-cash transaction in which Advanced Orthopedic shareholders will receive about $3 a share.
NovaCare said it is paying $14 million for the deal, as well as assuming certain liabilities.
Other terms were not disclosed. The deal is expected to close by December 31. It must be approved by Advanced Orthopedic shareholders.
